title: Great to organize your k-cups!
text:
Great to organize your k-cups!. This bamboo caddy for k-cups is fantastic. It doesn't take up much more room than the coffee maker itself so it saves space. It displays the coffee pods so that you can see all of them at once. No spinning a rack to see what you have in the back. These are also stackable, which is another great feature! You can put your teas in one, coffees in the other or whichever way, you prefer to organize them. The drawer works smoothly and the k-cups fit perfectly!

I have this in different colors. Love it!

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader 36 Capacity Bamboo K-Cup Single Serve Coffee Pod Storage Drawer with Lip Panel, Brown

description: Need more space to put all of your K-Cup pods? why not get this K-Cup drawer that will organize all of your Coffee pods the way you need it to be! don't rummage through all of the boxes to find the flavor you want. Instead just open the drawer and get what you want instantly. It's also made from bamboo for sturdiness.
